title: Qualitative and quantitative endothelium changes after cataract surgery: ultrasound phacoemulsification vs. nanolaser technique

license.statement: Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY), version not stated (article <license>)

indication: Senile nuclear cataract (LOCS III NO1-NO4), patients older than 50 years; excluded low preoperative ECD, guttata, pseudoexfoliation, glaucoma, uveitis, axial length 26 mm or more, diabetes; single surgeon; 2.2 mm clear corneal incision, DuoVisc, SA60AT IOL in both groups; eyes converted from nanolaser to ultrasound or with capsular rupture/vitreous loss excluded

groups.description: Group 1: conventional ultrasound phacoemulsification, horizontal phaco chop (Stellaris PC)
Group 2: nanosecond Nd:YAG laser phacolysis (Cetus A.R.C. Laser system) on the same aspiration/irrigation platform

exclusions.what: tab4 percent endothelial cell loss at 1 week by nuclear density
exclusions.reason: subgroups nested within the two arms with a single follow-up; the arm-level absolute ECD series is used
same groups' preoperative means as in Table 3 (more decimals); Table 3 carries the follow-up

notes: Group 1 = ultrasound phacoemulsification and group 2 = nanolaser phacolysis (Methods); the nanolaser technique is the investigational arm compared with conventional ultrasound, so it is recorded as treated.
Block-randomized prospective cohort (NCT05886283). The Table 3 caption footnote expands ECD as 'endothelial cell loss' while the table header reads ECD (cell/mm2).
Group sizes: the Abstract gives 74 eyes (40 and 34); Results say 74 eyes of 57 patients and also '40 patients in group 1 and 34 patients in group 2'; n is taken as 40 and 34 eyes.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central ECD by non-contact specular microscopy (Tomey EM-4000) of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 3 'Group 1' column, mean ± SD at preoperative, Day 7 (7/30.4375 months), 1, 3, 6 and 24 months; no per-visit n
